rationale: The source/caller make this a compact duration-filter label: the target key 30D maps to numeric value 30, between the 7D and 90D choices. BIPM Table 8 in the current 9th edition (version 4.01, June 2026) lists day with symbol d and gives 1 d = 24 h = 86 400 s; section 5.4.3 specifies a space between number and unit symbol. Thus 30 d is semantically exact and consistently formatted. As a numeral plus unit symbol it has no person, pronoun, verb, or form of address, so Spanish formal/informal register does not apply. The source key 30D remains a protected literal in code; no placeholders or markup are present or needed in the translated value.
placeholderMarkupAssessment: No placeholders or markup in source or target. The neighboring tooltip uses {days} separately; this label does not and the code supplies numeric value 30.
protectedLiteralAssessment: Caller source key "30D" and numeric range value 30 remain unchanged. Lowercase d is the unit symbol, not a translatable word.

externalReference.publisher: Bureau International des Poids et Mesures (BIPM)
externalReference.title: The International System of Units (SI), 9th edition, version 4.01, June 2026
sections: Table 8, p. 140: day, symbol d; 1 d = 24 h = 86 400 s.
Section 5.4.3, p. 145: a space separates the numeric value and unit symbol.
